name: Inline sonication package; three cells proposed
processFunction: Inline sonication package; three cells proposed

design.sonotrodeMaterial: Ti Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V), defined tip replacement interval
design.bypassProvision: Bypass around US-501 for start-up / maintenance (conceptual; details on P&ID)

operatingEnvelope.cavitationBackpressure: Maintain vendor-specified backpressure and flow at US-501 for stable cavitation (value not stated)
operatingEnvelope.outletTemperatureC: 30–40 (control TLGO outlet temperature prior to A-600 drying 'for stability'; temperature monitoring at US-501 outlet)
operatingEnvelope.acceptanceCriterion: NOT DEFINED — replace 'fully sonicated' with layer count / thickness (AFM), lateral-size PSD, viscosity or turbidity proxy; without it neither dose nor pass count can be set
operatingEnvelope.technologyBenchmark: Benchmark ultrasonic flow cells against high-pressure homogenisation (50–150 MPa, 1–3 passes), rotor–stator and the no-treatment case at equal kJ/kg solids before freezing the unit count

reviewFindings: Draft sends cooler outlet toward A-600 with an optional 507 recycle to T-501. Model returns cooled slurry to T-501 and uses proposed P-502 for accepted-product transfer. These paths are not an approved operating sequence.

Three modeled cells, energy dose, residence time, flow, backpressure, cooling duty and product quality require trials/vendor selection. Draft 1-2 wt% and 30-40 degC targets are not approved setpoints or equipment ratings.

Available sheet is Draft - Not for Use with revision XXX. Bypass is mentioned conceptually and degassing is suggested; neither is asserted as an installed or connected package. Draft says no added water or DMF for sonication.
Pressure/vacuum and relief sizing, cooling-loss response, acoustic protection, CIP isolation, sampling criteria, vent compatibility and drain receiving conditions remain unqualified.

identity.designConcept: Dose-controlled cavitation loop, not a single flow cell: datasheet to carry acceptance criterion, cumulative dose D_total (J/mL and kJ/kg solids), dose per pass, pass count N, loop RTD, cavitation-field variables
identity.decisionGate: Close the A-500 decision through Management of Change with the updated PFD, dose specification, concentration basis and pilot response data before procurement

safeguards.enclosure: Retain acoustic shielding, vibration isolation and maintenance bypass as drawn; add enclosure interlocks
